## 🍩 Glaze & Grind

**▶ Play in your browser:** https://jaineil32624.github.io/glaze-and-grind/play/

| Download | File |
|---|---|
| 📱 Android | `GlazeAndGrind.apk` — enable "Install unknown apps" for your browser/file manager |
| 🪟 Windows | `GlazeAndGrind.exe` — single file, just run it (SmartScreen: *More info → Run anyway*) |
| 🐧 Linux | `GlazeAndGrind.x86_64` — `chmod +x` then run |
| 🌐 Web | `GlazeAndGrind-web.zip` — host on any static server |
| 📦 Source | *Source code (zip)* below — open `project.godot` in Godot 4.3 |

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/jaineil32624/glaze-and-grind/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for what's new.

> The Android APK is signed with a debug key for testing. For the Play Store, export the **Android AAB** preset with your own release keystore.
